song_craft: Seal song (8v): girt-am → nectar-life → eightfold-circle → seals-all → loosed-called → draught-dwells → moment-rises → effortless-all. Treatise seals effortless.

lines: Girt with burning-ground garlands, ghouls around — measuring sense-fields' midst shown —

verses.craft: Girt-measured; am-I close (identity stated in cremation-ground).

lines: In You alone — nectar-streak, supreme-power-made, last knower —
hence Lord — You alone worlds' life — shine in our hearts.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvayy evāmṛtalekhā paraśaktimayī parapramātātaḥ nātha tvam eva jagatām jīvanam iti bhāsi no hṛdaye

lines: Yours — sound-mass-bodied, eightfold-warded — outer circle just;
by finest splits and finer, Bhairava, world-lords-led.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tava śabdarāśivapuṣaḥ pratyaṣṭakam eva bāhyaparivāraḥ parasūkṣmādivibhedād bhairava lokeśvarapramukhāḥ

lines: It seals all this — total self-form given over —
gladdens the devotee-throng, path-joyed, by showing full.
